title: Fisher 440A Tube Power Amplifier Recapped with Bluetooth Tube Preamp

Here for sale is a clean Fisher 6bq5/ el84 model 440 A stereo power tube amp pulled from a 1961 custom Electra console.

The amp comes with original Fisher driver tubes and a matched pair each of Electro-Harmonix and Tube Amp Doctor 6bq5 power tubes.
Also included is a Douk tube preamp with remote, Bluetooth, RCA, Coax and USB inputs.  The amp and preamp make a versatile and great sounding system.
I have it set up with a pair of 2 way Yamaha NS-500 speakers, which I could include in a package deal.  I have a few other more vintage speakers that would work well with it.
Also, I have a Cambridge Audio Azur 540P phono preamp that can be added to the system for ab additional $50.  Also, a sweet running restored Garrard Lab 80 turntable is available for $250.
Take it all home – Fisher amp. Douk preamp. Cambridge phono amp, Garrard Lab 80 for $750, add $300 for the  Yamaha NS-500 speakers.

title: Antique UPRR train track level inclinometer Union Pacific Rail Road rr
description:
This is a very cool vintage railroad level for checking the grade or pitch on the train tracks as they were laid.
Other inclinometers that I have had were fancy models and in great condition and I assume they were gently used by an inspector.
This one has been well used although still in great shape. The condition makes me imagine that it was carried and used as the tracks were laid.
It’s marked UPRR in two places. It’s my understanding that Union Pacific used the UPRR designation until they were done building the Transcontinental Railroad in the mid/late 1800s so this is a very old piece of history. They then changed the name to Union Pacific Railway and used the UPR designation.
It’s also marked with what looks like EV. 6- 66 and the brass level bubble is marked Empire 58”R
It measures 62 1/2” long and the brass elevation ruler is graduated up to 7”
This is an awesome piece of railroading and American history and will make a very nice addition to your collection.
If you know of a nice train museum please let me know or show them this ad and have them contact me.
Thanks

title: MCS  6604 Direct Drive Turntable  NICE!
description: The MCS 6604 is an excellent, highly reliable vintage entry-level turntable built by Technics (Panasonic) for JC Penney's "Modular Component Systems" house brand. Underneath its department store badge, it is essentially a rebadged Technics SL-Q200. The MCS 6604 is a sleeper vintage unit that offers exceptional value because it avoids the price premium attached to the "Technics" name while retaining the identical underlying Japanese build quality. Key Performance Features include Quartz-Locked Direct Drive: Unlike belt-driven starter tables, its direct-drive motor is regulated by a quartz oscillator. This eliminates belt decay issues and provides near-perfect speed stability with virtually non-existent wow and flutter. Semi-Automatic Operation: The table offers auto-return functionality, meaning the tonearm will automatically lift and return to its rest when the record finishes playing, protecting your stylus from unnecessary wear. P-Mount (T4P) Tonearm System: It utilizes a standard P-mount plug-in cartridge setup (originally shipping with a Technics P23 cartridge). This completely removes the need for complex alignment, overhang adjustments, or tracking force calibration, making it incredibly user-friendly for vinyl beginners. I have replaced the original cartridge and stylus with a new Audio-Technica cartridge. Table is clean and works great. Dust cover is intact and has a few scratches from previous owner use. This is a nice plug and play table. Meet up either evenings at QT in Independence at Sterling and Truman Rd, or workdays in downtown KCK.  I will not respond to "Is This Available?" requests. If you see it, its available. Thanks for looking!
ai_notes: [MCS 6604 Direct Drive Turntable] Technics-built vintage turntable.

title: Radio Shack MPA 250B Power Amplifier
description: The MPA-250B is highly regarded in the vintage community because it mimics the aesthetics and heavy-duty build of entry-level professional gear (like classic Crown amplifiers) without the pro-gear price tag. Key Specifications & Performance: Output Power: It pushes a healthy 125 Watts per channel into 8 ohms in standard stereo mode, or can be flipped to bridged mono mode to deliver 250 Watts into 8 ohms. Built-In Phono Stage: Unlike standard commercial PA gear, it includes a dedicated magnetic cartridge phono preamp input. This allows you to hook up a vintage turntable directly without needing a separate preamp box. Independent Controls & Utility: The faceplate features dual lighted LED power meters, left/right independent input gain adjustments, integrated EQ sliders, and an A/B speaker selector. Built-in Fan Cooling: A massive internal heat-sink and whisper-quiet fan keep the unit cool under long, continuous heavy loads. You are looking at an exceptionally versatile utility piece. If you plan to pair this with a vintage system—such as driving power-hungry vintage floor speakers or running a turntable directly into it—the built-in phono stage and raw power make it a fantastic bargain.  It also has four XLR balanced inputs for microphones. This was pulled from a church in south Kansas City during a upgrade in their AV systems. I had this unit serviced around six months ago.  Works fine but because of age sold as is.  Meet up evenings in Independence at QT at Sterling and Truman Rd, or weekdays in downtown KCK.  I will not respond to "Is This Available?" description:
*** POTTED CATALPAS less than 2 Feet tall $29 EACH*** 3 foot Catalpa $39 and 4 foot Catalpa $59.  Empress Trees potted 1 foot tree $59 on the last two pictures.. PLEASE DO BRING CASH we do not carry change. I have a very limited stock on hand this year. Please check the pictures and note that the Catalpas with large leaves. The pictures of the mature trees are examples. Catalpas grow very fast!! during the Fall season the trees start to lose their leaves after they have become yellow. You can plant until the ground freezes.  I can schedule appointments to see the trees on weekdays or week ends. Thank you.
Fast Growing Shade Tree With Amazing Spring Blooms.
Related to the Royal Empress tree, the Northern Catalpa tree, Catalpa Speciosa, is also a fast growing tree with amazing spring blooms. It would be outstanding as a unique, ornamental shade tree.
Large, showy white, trumpet-shaped flowers will put on quite a show in late spring. What a site this tree becomes when the huge white flowers create a stunning contrast against the solid green background of foliage! As an added bonus, the flowers attract hummingbirds!
As a member of the Bignonia Family, it is related to Trumpet Vine, Royal Paulownia, and other species of Catalpa, all of which are known for their showy flowers. This deciduous tree is also known as Hardy Catalpa, Western Catalpa, Cigar Tree, and Catawba-Tree.
The huge, heart shaped leaves can be as big as 12 inches across! They not only help block the sun on hot summer days, but also makes the chore of raking leaves a lot easier.
Farmers introduced Northern Catalpa to Ohio in order to produce large amounts of relatively lightweight timber for fence post since the wood is very resistant to rotting. Very tolerant of tough conditions, it withstands wet, dry, alkaline soils and hot, dry environments, but prefers moist, deep soil; should be planted in sun or partial shade.
For a hardy, fast-growing shade tree with ornamental spring blooms, you can't go wrong with the Northern Catalpa. Catalpas make great dwarf trees if pruned every year, but not bonsai trees due to the large leaves.
Fishermen: Grow your own Catalpa worms (the larval stage of the catalpa sphinx moth) are plump, black-and-yellow caterpillars highly prized by anglers as premium live bait, often called "catfish candy". They are the only caterpillar species that feed on catalpa trees and are known for their voracious appetites.

title: Viking F-1 2"/DN50 Straight Through Deluge Valve
description:
The Viking Model F-1 Deluge Valve is a quick opening, differential diaphragm, flood valve with one moving mechanism. The Deluge Valve is used to control water flow in Deluge and Pre-action sprinkler systems. The valve is held closed by system water pressure trapped in the priming chamber, keeping the outlet chamber and system piping dry. In fire conditions, when the releasing system operates, pressure is released from the priming chamber. The Deluge Valve clapper opens to allow water to flow into the system piping.

title: Black and Decker 10" bandsaw.    Modified for 240 volts
description:
Up for sale is a tinkerers dream.   I bought this saw with the idea of re sawing wood for my lathe work.  It had a 1/5 hp motor as is usual with these tools.   Way under powered.  So I installed a 1/3 hp condenser motor from a A/C condenser.  So much better.   But it was 240 volts.  A small issue so I installed a long extension cord that plugged in to my welding outlet.   Or a drier outlet also works  fine.
So it uses a 56 1/8" blade.  Saws fine but being 3 wheels, can be a bit tricky on tracking and tension.  Included is extension cord, three blades,  miter gage and the old motor as it still works fine.
I purchased a vintage Delta 10" cast iron band saw to replace it.
If needed and you bring a drier plug with you, I can replace the welder plug with that one.  You can,  however, replace the motor with the old one, but it is just a dog on sawing, so just saying......

From wide-angle landscapes to medium-telephoto portraiture, the FUJINON XF 16-55mm F2.8 R LM WR lens offers unparalleled versatility and superior image quality. This weather-resistant zoom lens boasts a constant aperture of F2.8 across its entire focal range, equivalent to 24mm at wide-angle through to 84mm at medium-telephoto.
Engineered with an advanced optical design, this lens controls various forms of aberration to deliver edge-to-edge sharpness across the entire zoom range. The inclusion of a newly-developed Nano-GI (Gradient Index) coating technology effectively inhibits ghosting and flare, producing clear, high-quality images.
Ideal for a wide range of shooting scenes, this lens covers everything from the wide-angle 24mm equivalent suitable for landscape photography, to the medium-telephoto 84mm equivalent, perfect for capturing stunning portraits.

In order to achieve best-in-class image quality, this fast standard zoom lens comprises 17 elements in 12 groups. This includes three aspherical lens elements to control spherical aberration and distortion, and three ED glass lens elements to reduce lateral chromatic aberration (wide-angle) and axial chromatic aberration (telephoto).
The lens also features Fujifilm's unique HT-EBC (High Transmittance Electron Beam Coating) applied to the entire lens surface, ensuring ghosting and flare are controlled for sharp, clear images. The lens also offers high-speed, quiet autofocus thanks to the Linear Motor and an Inner Focusing System. The fastest AF speed of 0.06 seconds, combined with the near-silent shutter sound, allows for discreet photography in quiet locations.
The FUJINON XF 16-55mm F2.8 R LM WR lens is not only high-performing but also boasts a high build quality with a metal exterior and focus and aperture rings for a refined finish. The lens mount is made from brass for improved strength. The AF+MF function enables seamless manual focusing, allowing for fine adjustments after autofocusing on the subject.
This lens is approximately 60% of the weight of a full-size system when combined with a camera body, significantly reducing the burden on the photographer and ensuring ease of use. Whether you're a professional photographer or an enthusiast, this lens is a valuable addition to your photography gear, offering high-quality images, versatility, and durability.

title: Vintage Heathkit AS-101 / Altec Lansing Valencia-Style Speakers
description:
For sale is a pair of vintage Heathkit AS-101 speakers, built by the owner in 1972. These are the desirable Heathkit version of the classic Altec Lansing Valencia-style speaker, using Altec Lansing components and drivers clearly marked Altec Lansing.
The Altec Lansing Valencia is one of the classic home hi-fi speakers from the golden age of American audio. It is closely related to Altec’s legendary Voice of the Theatre speaker line, which was originally designed for powerful, clear, highly efficient theater sound. The Valencia brought much of that same horn-loaded Altec character into a furniture-grade home speaker system suitable for serious home listening.
These Heathkit AS-101 speakers deliver the classic Altec sound: open, dynamic, efficient, and very natural. They produce a large, room-filling soundstage with excellent vocal presence, strong center imaging, and a wide sense of space. Music sounds lively and effortless, especially with jazz, vocals, acoustic music, classic rock, orchestral music, and tube or solid-state amplification.
Details:
Pair of vintage Heathkit AS-101 speakers
Altec Lansing Valencia-style design
Built by the owner in 1972
Altec Lansing drivers clearly marked
8 ohm speakers
Crossovers rebuilt in 2025
Cabinets refinished in 2010
Classic horn-loaded Altec sound
Large, open soundstage
Clear vocals and strong dynamics
Excellent choice for a vintage audio system or dedicated listening room
Speakers: Altec Lansing 15 woofer, 10-1/2 pound magnet assembly.  High frequency driver, 13 ounce Alnico V magnet with 800 sectoral horn.
The rebuilt crossovers are a major plus, since crossover age is one of the most common concerns with vintage speakers from this era. The cabinets were refinished in 2010 and present well.
These are serious vintage speakers for someone who understands Altec Lansing, Heathkit AS-101, Valencia-style speakers, or Voice of the Theatre heritage.
Local pickup only. Buyer should bring proper help and a suitable vehicle, as these are large and heavy speakers.  The speakers weigh 101 pounds each.

title: Beatles pinball machine
description:
To protect myself, payment must be made in cash.  My price is firm so no offers please.
I never thought I'd have to say goodbye to my all-time favorite pinball machine because I'm moving and I have to downsize.  First of all I'm a huge fan of the Beatles.  This pinball machine encompasses the best of two worlds: old-school speed matched with new technology.  Essentially, this means you don't have to wait for the ball to essentially disappear as seen in the new games, but rather, there's no waiting for the ball to return.  Everything listed here is part of a package, so I won't separate any items from the sale.  This machine has not been played much since I am protecting it as a collectible.  My price is firm so no offers taken.
As the most influential band in music history, The Beatles is a property that people old and young can instantly recognize. To celebrate such an incredible legacy, Stern Pinball has created the first and only Beatles-themed pinball machine: The Beatles – Beatlemania.  Rated 8 out of 10 on Pinside.
Based upon a classic 1980 Stern pinball table called Seawitch, that older table has been completely re-themed to focus on The Beatles when they began their international “British Invasion” in 1964. The likenesses of John Lennon, Paul McCartney, George Harrison and Ringo Starr (the “Fab Four”) from this era are found on the cabinet, sporting their iconic blue suits. As the game layout is essentially the same as a classic game, this title feels like it came from the 1960’s, playing as a simple game that people of any skillset can enjoy.
The Beatles does more than just re-themes an old game with new artwork however. All of the electronics are modern, with Stern’s SPIKE-2 system managing the components; lights replaced with long-lasting LEDs; a sharp HD display built into the back box for vibrant animations and remastered clips and more. Custom speech has been provided for the game by the legendary disc jockey Cousin Brucie, who introduced The Beatles at New York’s Shea Stadium in 1964. The playfield has two new feature additions that elevate the game beyond Seawitch – first, a magnet at the top of the playfield; second, a spinning disc in the center of the playfield that looks like a vinyl record.
STERN PINBALL’S THE BEATLES PINBALL (GOLD EDITION) FEATURES
•	The first and only licensed pinball table based upon The Beatles
•	Limited production! Only 1,614 Gold Edition models were made. Out of stock.
•	Retro style gameplay that fits with the 1960’s aesthetic
•	Features nine Beatles hits: A Hard Day’s Night, Can’t Buy Me Love, Ticket to Ride, All My Loving, Help, Drive My Car, It Won’t Be Long, I Should Have Known Better, & Taxman
•	Four flippers, 11 drop targets, two opto-spinners, 8 stand up targets, multiball modes
•	Bright & balanced LED lighting
•	Special features: Magnet and disc spinner, the latter designed to look like a vinyl record
•	Supports 1-4 players (taking turns)
•	HD display shows vibrant animations, clips of the band and Ed Sullivan, scoring and more
•	All music & sounds are pumped through a hi-fidelty 3-channel sound amp
•	Separate treble & bass adjustment controls
•	Includes a standard two-slot coin door; DBA ready or Free Play available
